reason: Verified that the QA-20261016-014505-zosr agent successfully receives and responds to a simple arithmetic question with the correct answer containing "4".
steps: Navigated to http://localhost:47891 - Successfully loaded the Gamut app homepage showing the sidebar with available agents and main content area.
Located and clicked the "QA-20261016-014505-zosr" agent in the sidebar - Successfully clicked the agent link and navigated to its detail page.
Verified agent status is "running" or "idle" - Agent status displays "idle" in the top right corner of the page, which is one of the valid expected statuses.

Sent message "Hello! What is 2+2?" - Successfully typed the message into the message input field (data-testid='home-message-input') and clicked the Send button, creating a new session titled "Simple Arithmetic Question Check".
